text: Finance is a discipline that studies the flow of funds, resource allocation, and risk management. Its core lies in exploring "how money can flow efficiently in time and space". It encompasses both the macro-level operation of the financial system (such as how the central bank's monetary policy affects the economy) and the micro-level financial decisions (such as how enterprises raise funds and how individuals manage their finances). It is based on mathematics and economics and integrates knowledge from statistics, law, etc. It is a "bloodline" discipline for understanding the operation of modern economies - from bank deposits and loans, stock and bond investments, to new business models like blockchain and green finance, all fall within its research scope.
